opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as you are studying or working in the UK, or the course you wish to attend is being held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become Society members. Others should be a Society member for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,200 to enable members to attend formal short training courses or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: up to £750 (Adelphi co‑sponsored award); otherwise up to £500 or £200 depending on scheme

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of their PhD viva for Scheme A; PhD students and postdocs within six years of their PhD viva for Schemes B and C. Applicants must be UK‑based members (or non‑UK members attending a UK conference).
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences (Society meetings, SIG meetings, non‑Society meetings, and virtual conferences) with travel, accommodation and registration costs.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, provided they are studying or working in the UK, or intend to carry out fieldwork in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £2,000 to cover travel, accommodation, subsistence, consumables and essential equipment for field‑based genetic research projects; results should be suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member may apply at any time; meetings must be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetics‑themed meetings not organised directly by the Society, covering venue, speaker, and related costs; may include a Carer’s Award.

opportunities.title: Carer’s Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member can apply, regardless of the age of the person they are caring for.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £60 per day to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings or events.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants up to £1,000 for public engagement activities related to genetics, covering eligible travel and materials costs (UK‑based only).
